bridge.status: No Worker source change in 4.4.6.10; the browser-direct Canvas PDF path now authenticates to allowlisted Instructure file hosts. The existing private Worker fallback remains separately deployed.

deployment.preview: Published by the test-pinned GitHub Pages workflow only after the exact current preview branch head passes Phase 4 tests; see GitHub Actions for the latest run.
deployment.production: Published by the test-pinned GitHub Pages workflow only after the exact current main branch head passes Phase 4 tests; see GitHub Actions for the latest run.

versionPolicy: Every independently reviewable implementation, bridge, infrastructure, or deployment-configuration change receives a new NORTHSTAR micro-version and its own changelog entry.

releases.title: Authenticated Canvas PDF retrieval and release-record alignment
releases.description: Corrects browser-direct PDF downloads to use Canvas bearer authentication only with HTTPS Canvas/Instructure allowlisted file hosts, keeps browser cookies omitted, preserves the authenticated private-bridge fallback, and blocks untrusted metadata URLs. Clarifies the separate signed-upload security boundary and aligns release metadata and engineering documentation.
releases.status: Exact-head Phase 4 validation and Pages publication are tracked by GitHub Actions. Live Canvas account and physical iPad/Apple Pencil acceptance remain external checks.

releases.title: Manifest-driven browser boot version assertion
releases.description: Removes the last hardcoded NORTHSTAR version from the browser boot regression test. The test now reads release.json and compares the rendered version pill against the manifest, so future micro-version increments cannot cause stale test expectations.
releases.status: Deployed successfully to production and preview by GitHub Pages workflow run 45081377927. Phase 4 passed on main commit fe5b69948d98969768fb5dc155f6f41ab1d861a8 (run 45081323554) and preview commit fe5b69948d98969768fb5dc155f6f41ab1d861a8 (run 45081332111).

releases.title: Release deployment-history assertion correction
releases.description: Corrects release-history regression assertions to distinguish the current pending .8 candidate from the previously deployed .6 release. The test now validates .8 pending status and .6 deployment evidence/commit provenance independently.
releases.status: Phase 4 test failed on 2026-11-22 because the browser boot test contained a hardcoded 4.4.6.6 version. Superseded by 4.4.6.9, which reads the expected version from the release manifest.

releases.title: Pages freshness gate event handling
releases.description: Removes a redundant workflow_run event-type condition from the Pages build job. The authoritative freshness gate already requires successful Phase 4 push runs for both exact current branch heads; deployment now proceeds whenever that gate passes, regardless of which completed test event triggered the Pages workflow.
releases.status: Phase 4 test failed on 2026-11-22: the .7 regression test mistakenly asserted that the pending .7 candidate had the previous .6 release's deployment run ID. Superseded by 4.4.6.8.

releases.title: Release boot assertion and Pages workflow validation
releases.description: Updates the browser boot regression assertion to follow the current manifest version and removes a duplicate deploy-job dependency key that made the Pages workflow invalid. The deploy job now correctly depends on both freshness verification and artifact build.
releases.status: Deployed successfully to production and preview by GitHub Pages workflow run 45080756988. Phase 4 passed on main commit e849c91e68d006ff1187efa1d748a82b9f386fe7 (run 45080715004) and preview commit e8797f6148bd74cb9c6bf289e694b53bf549271c (run 45080603228).

releases.title: Release verification test correction
releases.description: Corrects the release regression test so an unreleased candidate is required to remain explicitly pending deployment rather than falsely requiring a Pages run ID copied from a prior release. Retains the test-pinned deployment gate and records the .4 candidate's failed validation accurately.
releases.status: Phase 4 test failed on 2026-11-22: the boot regression test still expected 4.4.6.3 after the release version advanced. Superseded by 4.4.6.6.

releases.title: Test-pinned deployment gate
releases.description: GitHub Pages now verifies that both current source branch heads have successful Phase 4 push runs and checks out those exact tested SHAs. Delayed successful workflow events cannot publish newer untested branch contents; if either channel lacks a passing run, publishing is held until that branch's own test succeeds.
releases.status: Phase 4 test failed on 2026-11-22 because the release regression test incorrectly required the current release to contain a previous release's Pages run ID. Not promoted; superseded by 4.4.6.5.

releases.title: Manifest-driven version identity
releases.description: Removes the legacy hardcoded .4.4.5 version constant from the dashboard renderer. The clickable version pill remains owned by the release module, settings read the current NORTHSTAR version from the release manifest, and the browser boot test verifies the visible version after dashboard initialization.
releases.status: Deployed successfully to production and preview by GitHub Pages workflow run 45068083612. The Phase 4 suite passed on main commit 34e5bc02d0233d32df974dbfecdc919e8e7f04d2 in workflow run 45068031155.

releases.title: Document Studio — interaction lifecycle and faithful text export
releases.description: Closes editor page-level hover listeners on unmount, preserves touch selection while using contextual text formatting, clears hover targets correctly, and improves PDF export for bulleted/numbered lists, paragraph spacing, justified text, and supported punctuation glyphs. Adds regression coverage for teardown and list conversion.
releases.status: Preview artifact deployed by Pages run 45067529386 from a stale earlier test event. The exact .2 Phase 4 suite failed its browser boot version-label assertion; .2 was not promoted to main and its editor/export fixes are included in 4.4.6.3.

releases.title: Document Studio — editable text-object foundation
releases.description: Replaces the one-shot text-entry workflow with direct on-page text objects. Adds a separate DOM text layer, create/select/edit flows, move and resize handles, typography controls, rich-text markup persistence, Pencil hover cursor and placement previews, and formatted PDF export using supported PDF standard-font families.
releases.status: Deployed to production and preview. GitHub Pages workflow run 45066524340 completed successfully for main commit a861a645cd0ce41dab60c06439b007ce470c09c3.

releases.title: Two-finger navigation pointer capture
releases.description: Captures both touch pointers during two-finger document navigation and preserves the selected input model while the gesture completes. Verified in the Phase 4 automated workflow.
releases.status: Automated Phase 4 workflow passed; physical Pencil hardware acceptance remains separate.

releases.title: Input mode persistence and tool independence
releases.description: Separates Hand/Finger and Apple Pencil input selection from the active annotation tool. Tool selection no longer silently changes the input mode, and the input choice persists when another PDF is opened.

releases.title: All annotation tools in both input modes
releases.description: Introduces a shared pointer/tool capability model so the supported annotation tools can be used with finger or mouse in Hand mode and Apple Pencil in Pencil mode. Adds mode/tool regression checks.

releases.title: Native assignment workspace and PDF Document Studio
releases.description: Introduces the in-dashboard assignment route, Canvas attachment retrieval, PDF.js rendering, page-level annotation tools, local annotation persistence, undo/redo, and flattened annotated-PDF export.
releases.status: Historical summary reconstructed from the repository engineering log and README; native Canvas DocViewer annotation-state submission is not claimed.
